description: This file contains utility functions for normalizing JSON schema types to lowercase, normalizing tool parameter schemas, and validating JSON responses against schemas. It's used within the litellm project for schema handling and validation.

methods.description: Normalizes a tool schema's parameters by converting type fields to lowercase.

methods.description: Validates a JSON response against a provided JSON schema, raising an error if validation fails.
